title: 1986 Leaf Wally Joyner California Angels Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1986 Leaf Wally Joyner All Star Pop Up trading card featuring the player Wally Joyner from the California Angels. It is an original sports trading card from the manufacturer Leaf, part of the MLB league. The card is from the 1986 season and is considered a Single in the set.
